category_title: Older preschool children expressing specific anxieties about environmental and relational consistency
scenario_title: Anxiety about material consistency during early conversations
minimal_context: The student and teacher are having an early conversation in the classroom about the upcoming building move.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to have a conversation about our upcoming move to the new school building.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm feeling a little nervous about moving. Will the globe go?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think will happen?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. Will the blocks go?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have a lot of things in the classroom to think about.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looking worried and focusing on another specific item) Will the tire swing go? I'm worried about if our things will be there.
